handle.directives:
SecRequestBodyAccess On
SecRuleEngine On
SecRequestBodyLimit 1048576
SecAuditEngine RelevantOnly
SecAuditLog /logs/waf-audit.log
SecAuditLogFormat JSON
SecAuditLogParts ABFHZ
SecAction "id:1899999100,phase:2,pass,nolog,noauditlog,mlcheck"
SecRule TX:argus_is_clean "@streq 0" "id:1899999101,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,auditlog,msg:'Argus v4 blocked',tag:'argus-sentinel/v4',logdata:'attack_prob=%{tx.argus_risk_score}'"
SecRule TX:argus_error "@rx .+" "id:1899999102,phase:2,pass,log,auditlog,msg:'Argus v4 unavailable',tag:'argus-sentinel/error',logdata:'reason=%{tx.argus_error}'"
